what: NYC LION Single Line Street Network
title: NYC LION Single Line Street Network
text: nyclion package bundles New York City Department City Planning’s LION File Geodatabase, single-line representation every NYC street segment plus rich set administrative, traffic, geocoding attributes. also includes node points, node--street-name lookup, alternate-names table used NYC’s Geosupport System geocoding. LION comprehensive simpler NYC Open Data street centerline shipped nycstreets package: covers non-street linear features (shoreline, railroads, district boundaries, paper streets, alleys, ferry routes), carries side-specific census / borough / community-district / electoral fields, exposes LGC / join_id keys DCP’s geocoder depends .

title: NYC LION street segments — nyc_lion_sf
text: Single-line representation New York City streets, address ranges rich set administrative, traffic, geocoding attributes. Also includes non-street linear features shoreline, railroads, district boundaries, paper / private streets, alleys, walking paths, ferry routes. See feature_typ feature classification.

title: NYC LION street segments — nyc_lion_sf
text: simple feature collection 242,121 rows 93 columns (linestring / multilinestring geometry): street Street non-street feature name used labeling. saf_street_name Special Address Form street name. Populated spec_addr non-blank. feature_typ Feature Type Code. One : 0 street (vehicle ), 1 railroad, 2 water edge / shoreline, 3 census block boundary, 5 paper street, 6 private street, 7 district boundary, 8 physical non-street boundary, 9 paper street + census/district boundary, alley, W non-vehicular addressable path, C CCO (Corporation Counsel Opinion), F ferry route. segment_typ Segment Type. Defines status relation horizontal-topology enhancements. Values: B generic roadbed, C connector adjacent roadbeds, E ramp, F faux segment, G generic, R roadbed, T terminator, U undivided, S suppressed. inc_ex_flag Inclusion / exclusion flag used NYPD's ETL mark pedestrian walkways / greenways exclusion. rb_layer Roadbed-layer flag. R roadbed , G generic , B , N neither. non_ped Non-pedestrian indicator. V vehicle-, D pedestrian-accessible excluded DOE walking-route logic. traf_dir Traffic Direction. W segment direction (one-way), segment direction (one-way), T two-way, P pedestrian path, blank non-street features. traf_src Source traf_dir value: DCP DOT. spec_addr Special Address Type Code (e.g., alternative address ranges, duplicate addresses, complex names, vanity addresses). Blank standard segments. face_code Four-digit face code. component LIONkey identifier (Boro + face_code + seq_num). seq_num Five-digit sequence number within face code. street_code Six-digit street code: leading borough digit + five-digit street code. saf_street_code Special Address Form street code, spec_addr non-blank. lgc1, lgc2, lgc3, lgc4, lgc5, lgc6, lgc7, lgc8, lgc9 Local Group Codes. Qualifiers five-digit street code; LGC groups street names valid segment. boe_lgc Board Elections LGC pointer (1–4) indicating lgc field corresponds BOE-applicable name. segment_id Seven-digit, zero-padded identifier physical street segment. Stable across LION key segment spans borough boundary. seg_count Segment count. loc_status Local-status flag. l_zip, r_zip ZIP code left / right side segment. l_boro, r_boro Borough code (1=Manhattan, 2=Bronx, 3=Brooklyn, 4=Queens, 5=Staten Island) left / right side. l_cd, r_cd Community District. Three bytes: borough digit plus two-digit district number, JIA code joint interest areas (parks, airports). latomicpolygon, ratomicpolygon DCP atomic polygon ID left / right side. lct2020, lct2020suf 2020 census tract suffix, left side. rct2020, rct2020suf 2020 census tract suffix, right side. lcb2020, lcb2020suf 2020 census block suffix, left side. rcb2020, rcb2020suf 2020 census block suffix, right side. l_assm_dist, r_assm_dist NYS assembly district, left / right side. l_elect_dist, r_elect_dist Election district, left / right side. split_elect Split-election-district flag. l_schl_dist, r_schl_dist School district, left / right side. split_schl Split-school-district flag. l_sub_sect, r_sub_sect Sub-section identifier, left / right side. san_dist_ind Sanitation-district indicator. map_from, map_to Boundary-mapping flags ends segment. boro_bndry Borough-boundary flag segments lying along borough boundary. mh_ri_flag Manhattan / Roosevelt-Island flag. curve_flag Curve flag. radius Curve radius feet (0 non-curved segments). node_id_from, node_id_to Node IDs start end segment (joins nyc_lion_nodes_sf). node_level_f, node_level_t Node-level codes ends. con_parity Connection-parity flag. twisted Twisted-segment flag segments left / right swapped relative digitization direction. rw_type Right--way type code. physical_id Physical-segment ID. generic_id Generic-segment ID. nypdid NYPD segment identifier, applicable. fdnyid FDNY segment identifier, applicable. l_block_face_id, r_block_face_id Block-face IDs left / right side segment. legacy_id Legacy segment identifier. status Segment status code. street_width_min, street_width_max Minimum maximum curb--curb street width feet. bike_lane Bike-lane class code. bike_trafdir Bike-traffic direction code. posted_speed Posted speed limit miles per hour. snow_priority Snow-removal priority class. number_travel_lanes Number travel lanes. number_park_lanes Number parking lanes. number_total_lanes Total number lanes (travel + parking). from_left, to_left Address range left side segment (low / high house numbers). from_right, to_right Address range right side segment. join_id Identifier used join LION segments nyc_lion_altnames_df geocoding. Concatenates Boro / face_code / lgc1..lgc4, , Special Address records, Boro / street_code / lgc1..lgc4 / spec_addr. l_pd_service_area, r_pd_service_area NYPD service-area codes left / right side. truck_route_type Truck-route classification code. SHAPE Linestring / multilinestring geometry EPSG:2263.

title: NYC LION street segments — nyc_lion_sf
text: columns "side-specific", carrying separate values left right sides segment along directional node node (e.g., l_boro / r_boro, l_zip / r_zip, l_ct2020 / r_ct2020). LION codes preserve original string formatting (zero-padded applicable). Source CRS EPSG:2263, NAD83 / New York Long Island (ftUS). Roughly 25 columns dropped source: pre-2020 census fields, geometry-redundant coordinates, duplicate hyphenated address ranges, handful always-empty fields. See upstream metadata full LION schema. Edition 25C, "BYTES BIG APPLE", published 2025-08-18 NYC Department City Planning. Update frequency quarterly. LION spatially aligned NYCMap aerial photography. background street_code, LGC system, join_id construction, Joint Interest Areas (community-district codes major parks airports), conventions handling alternate / vanity / duplicate street names, see upstream ReadMe.txt LION metadata PDF bundled source data.

title: NYC LION street segments — nyc_lion_sf
text: Kieran Healy
